name: claude-design
description: Slop-resistant prompt packages for Claude Design. Two skills: design-prompt turns a rough idea (and optional inspiration screenshots) into a master design-system prompt plus iteration follow-ups; screen-prompts researches the app, interrogates the user (via /grill-me when installed), maps every screen, and generates per-screen prompts plus an interactive device-frame canvas prompt for click-through testing mobile apps. Reference graphics via the Deeporax connector.
